question: The much-loved English novel, ‘Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland’ was written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lewis Carroll**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lewis Carroll is the pen name of Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, an English writer, mathematician, and logician.
 
• He was born on January 27, 1832, and died on January 14, 1898.
 
• Lewis Carroll is best known for his literary works, especially "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland" (1865) and its sequel "Through the Looking-Glass" (1871).
 
• His work is characterized by the use of wordplay, logic, and fantasy, making it popular among both children and adults.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Herman Melville**

 
 
• Herman Melville was an American novelist, short story writer, and poet of the American Renaissance period.
 
• He is best known for his novel "Moby-Dick" (1851).
 
• His other notable works include "Typee" (1846) and "Billy Budd, Sailor" (posthumously published in 1924).
 
 
 
• **Edgar Allan Poe**
 
 
• Edgar Allan Poe was an American writer, poet, editor, and literary critic.
 
• Poe is best known for his poetry and short stories, particularly his tales of mystery and the macabre.
 
• His notable works include "The Raven" (1845), "The Tell-Tale Heart" (1843), and "The Fall of the House of Usher" (1839).
 
 
 
• **Mary Shelley**
 
 
• Mary Shelley was an English novelist, best known for her Gothic novel "Frankenstein: or, The Modern Prometheus" (1818).
 
• She also edited and promoted the works of her husband, the Romantic poet and philosopher Percy Bysshe Shelley.
 
• Her other works include "The Last Man" (1826) and "Valperga" (1823).
